exercises.task: Print the numbers 1 to 5, each on its own line.
exercises.hint: If i starts at 0, the number you want is i + 1.

exercises.task: Fix the off-by-one bug so every item prints once.
exercises.hint: The last valid index is length - 1. Use < instead of <=.

exercises.task: Complete the function so it returns the largest number in the list.
exercises.hint: Start at index 1. If nums[i] is bigger than best, replace best.
